description: This file defines functions and logic for generating and sanitizing a Swagger/OpenAPI specification for an Express application, including loading a prebuilt spec, falling back to JSDoc extraction, and ensuring spec validity.

methods.name: buildCommonComponents
methods.description: Builds reusable components like parameters and schemas for the OpenAPI spec.

methods.name: buildJsDocSpec
methods.description: Creates a Swagger spec from JSDoc annotations as a fallback.

methods.name: sanitizeOpenApiDoc
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates an OpenAPI document object, ensuring paths start with '/', required fields exist, and components are included.

methods.name: getBaseOpenApiSpec
methods.description: Main function to retrieve the base OpenAPI specification, loading from file or generating via JSDoc.
